'''Drov''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who worked as one of [[Crying Dawn Singer]]'s back-up [[Musician/Legends|singers]] with fellow Ithorian Guerglenar. Drov was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agents from the [[Interrogation (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|Interrogation]] branch after the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Yearo Seville]] [[Operation 45RA|kidnapped]] Crying Dawn Singer by being placed in a portable [[compression/desiccation chamber]].
